description: This file defines the NotPositiveException class, which is a custom exception used to indicate that a provided numerical argument is not positive. It extends NumberIsTooSmallException and provides constructors for creating exceptions with or without a localized context.

classes.name: NotPositiveException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating an argument was not positive, inheriting from NumberIsTooSmallException.

methods.name: NotPositiveException(Number value)
methods.description: Constructs a NotPositiveException for the given argument value.

methods.name: NotPositiveException(Localizable specific, Number value)
methods.description: Constructs a NotPositiveException with a specific localized context.
